name: Fabled Passage

abilities.text: {T}, Sacrifice ~: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land.

notes: search-land does not bind what it found (game.ts never calls noteAffected for it), so 'untap that land' would untap nothing. A move out of the library is the same search - a choose-cards over the library, filtered to basic lands - and it does bind 'those', so the follow-up untap reaches the land that just entered. The explicit shuffle keeps the library randomised.

issues: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. — expected A library search you may fail to find in (the controller may decline to take a basic land even when one is there). — scripted move { what:{zone:'library', who:'you', count:1, choose:'you', filter:{types:['Land'],basic:true}} }. chooseFrom (game.ts:1688-1706) asks with exact:true and auto-takes when n>=cands.length, so finding is MANDATORY whenever a basic land is in the library. Practically always the right play, so no observed behavioural divergence, but the optionality of CR 701.19c is not modelled. — CR CR 701.19c

Search your library for a basic land card — expected A library search (visible as a search event to 'whenever a player searches their library' effects, opposing search-hate, etc.). — scripted Modelled as a `move` out of the library, not the `search`/`search-land` op, so nothing that keys off searching a library sees it. The notes state the reason explicitly (search-land never binds what it found, so 'untap that land' would untap nothing); the trade is documented and the central clause of the card works. — CR CR 701.19a

Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land. — expected Counted after the fetched land has entered, and it untaps only the land just put onto the battlefield. — scripted conditional {lands-ge 4} then untap 'that', sequenced after the move; opMove sets item.affected to what moved (game.ts:1740), so 'that' is the fetched land and the count includes it. Correct.

{T}, Sacrifice ~: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land. — expected a library search may fail to find even when a basic land is present — scripted the search is a `move` out of the library with count 1, and chooseFrom asks with exact:true (game.ts:1705) — the controller cannot decline. Only-upside effect, so no observable divergence in practice, but the 'may fail to find' option is not expressible here. — CR 701.19c

Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land. — expected count lands you control after the fetched land has entered; untap exactly that land — scripted correct — conditional lands-ge 4 (characteristics.ts:428 counts only your battlefield) with untap target 'that' bound by move's item.affected (game.ts:1740); the self-sacrifice is a cost so the Passage is already gone. 3/3 scenarios pass. — CR 118.9 / 608.2
